server.name: io.github.vish288/mcp-atlassian-extended
server.description: MCP server for Jira and Confluence — sprints, agile boards, attachments, versions, calendars.

environmentVariables.description: Jira instance URL (e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net)
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Jira personal access token (also accepts JIRA_PAT)
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Confluence instance URL (optional, for Confluence tools)
environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Confluence personal access token (also accepts CONFLUENCE_PAT)
environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Restrict to read-only operations (true/false)
environmentVariables.name: ATLASSIAN_READ_ONLY
